an3.98:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.98:1.3: idha bhikkhave, rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.98:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅganttheva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.98:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an3.98:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.98:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.98:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an3.98:3.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati …pe… thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an3.98:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an3.98:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.98:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an3.98:4.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
